title: Synthesis, crystallographic, DNA binding, and molecular docking/dynamic studies of a privileged chalcone-sulfonamide hybrid scaffold as a promising anticancer agent.
authors: Shaldam, Moataz; Tawfik, Haytham; Elmansi, Heba; Belal, Fathalla; Yamaguchi, Koki; Sugiura, Masaharu; Magdy, Galal
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过光谱、分子对接和动力学模拟研究查尔酮-磺酰胺杂合分子与小牛胸腺DNA的小沟结合，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作（此处为小分子-DNA）且方法可迁移，但对象非TF-DNA体系，故评5分。
abstract: In the present study, a drug-like molecular hybrid structure between chalcone and sulfonamide moieties was synthesized and characterized. The structural peculiarities of the synthesized hybrid were further verified by means of single crystal X-ray crystallography. Furthermore, its biological activity as an anticancer agent was evaluated. The synthesized model of chalcone-sulfonamide hybrid 3 was found to have potent anticancer properties against the studied cancer cell lines. Hence, the in vitro binding interaction of hybrid 3 with Calf thymus DNA (CT-DNA) was studied at a simulated physiological pH to confirm its anticancer activity for the first time. This was investigated by applying different spectroscopic techniques, ionic strength measurements, viscosity measurements, thermodynamics, molecular dynamic simulation and molecular docking studies. The obtained results showed a clear binding interaction between hybrid 3 and CT-DNA with a moderate affinity via a minor groove binding mechanism. The binding constant (K(b)) at 298 K calculated from the Benesi-Hildebrand equation was found to be 3.49 x 10(4) M(-1). The entropy and enthalpy changes (DeltaS(0) and DeltaH(0)) were 204.65 J mol(-1) K(-1) and 35.08 KJ mol(-1), respectively, indicating that hydrophobic interactions constituted the major binding forces. The results obtained from molecular docking and dynamic simulation studies confirmed the minor groove binding interaction and the stability of the formed complex. This study can contribute to further understanding of the molecular mechanism of hybrid 3 as a potential antitumor agent and can also guide future clinical and pharmacological studies for rational drug design with enhanced or more selective activity and greater efficacy.[Figure: see text]Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，合成并表征了一种查尔酮与磺酰胺部分之间的类药分子杂合结构。通过单晶X射线晶体学进一步验证了所合成杂合物的结构特性。此外，评估了其作为抗癌剂的生物活性。所合成的查尔酮-磺酰胺杂合物3被发现对所研究的癌细胞系具有强效抗癌特性。因此，首次在模拟生理pH条件下研究了杂合物3与小牛胸腺DNA（CT-DNA）的体外结合相互作用，以确认其抗癌活性。这通过应用不同的光谱技术、离子强度测量、粘度测量、热力学、分子动力学模拟和分子对接研究进行了探究。获得的结果显示，杂合物3与CT-DNA之间存在清晰的结合相互作用，具有中等亲和力，通过小沟结合机制实现。根据Benesi-Hildebrand方程计算，298 K下的结合常数（K(b)）为3.49 x 10(4) M(-1)。熵变和焓变（DeltaS(0)和DeltaH(0)）分别为204.65 J mol(-1) K(-1)和35.08 KJ mol(-1)，表明疏水相互作用构成了主要结合力。从分子对接和动力学模拟研究获得的结果证实了小沟结合相互作用以及所形成复合物的稳定性。本研究有助于进一步理解杂合物3作为潜在抗肿瘤剂的分子机制，并可为未来临床和药理学研究提供指导，以进行合理药物设计，增强或提高选择性活性及更大疗效。[图：见正文]由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
